newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates tumble on surplus funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates tumble on surplus funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates tumbled at Friday's close on excess liquidity and dealers said rates will stay low at Saturday's opening.

"As expected the overnight market opened on a liquid note. From the start heavy lending pressure was seen and initial deals were done at around 10 to 11 percent," a dealer said. "The closing hour even saw some deals done at four to five percent, with some banks reported left holding surplus funds," another dealer said.
Dealers said on Saturday the rates are likely to stay low because of surplus funds. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
